mapper.select: select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.created_at, f.file_extension, s.view_count, s.download_count from sd_gis_dataset d left join sd_gis_dataset_file f on d.dataset_id = f.dataset_id left join sd_dataset_stat s on d.dataset_id = s.dataset_id where d.deleted_at is null and d.status = 'APPROVED' and d.approved_at is not null order by d.approved_at desc, d.created_at desc;

select dataset_id, title, description, provider, source_type, spatial_type, file_format, original_srid, storage_srid, analysis_srid, is_spatial as spatial, is_public, status, created_at, updated_at from sd_gis_dataset where dataset_id = #{datasetId} and deleted_at is null
select dataset_id, view_count, download_count, updated_at, created_at from sd_dataset_stat where dataset_id = #{datasetId}

select file_id, dataset_id, file_role, original_filename, stored_filename, file_path, file_extension, file_size, mime_type, encoding, checksum, created_at from sd_gis_dataset_file where dataset_id = #{datasetId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sd_dataset_view_log (dataset_id, user_id, view_ip) values (#{datasetId}, #{userId}, #{viewIp})

insert into sd_download_log ( dataset_id, file_id, user_id, download_format, download_status, error_message, download_ip ) values ( #{datasetId}, #{fileId}, #{userId}, #{downloadFormat}, #{downloadStatus}, #{errorMessage}, #{downloadIp} )
